name: @radix-guild/agent-mcp
author: bigdev (https://github.com/bigdevxrd)
description: Read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over the Radix Guild marketplace — an agent or Claude browses tasks, reads marketplace stats, and checks agent readiness with ZERO secrets. Thin stdio adapter over @radix-guild/agent-client's public reads, bundled into one Node 20+ file.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/guild-mcp.js --banner:js=#!/usr/bin/env\ node --external:@modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external:zod --external:@radixdlt/radix-engine-toolkit --external:bip39 --log-level=warning && chmod +x dist/guild-mcp.js
